prompt:
A high-fidelity flat UI design mockup of a desktop web application screen, rendered straight-on with no perspective, no device frame, no hands, no room. This is a screen design, not a photograph or poster.

LAYOUT SKELETON, top to bottom, stated literally:

1. A full-width horizontal navigation beam, 56px tall, solid near-black carbon (#17161a). At its left the wordmark "PLIA" in condensed uppercase sans, beside it three small uppercase labels "TABLEAU DE BORD", "TRANSACTIONS", "HISTORIQUE" with the last underlined by a 2px red rule. At its right two thin line icons and a circular avatar initial.

2. Below the beam, on a warm light concrete-grey ground (#e6e3df) with faint concrete grain, a row of three small square account tabs with 45-degree cut corners.

3. THE MAIN ELEMENT, a master-detail split occupying the rest of the screen, on a light plate (#eeece8) with 45-degree cut corners:
   - LEFT, taking about 78% of the width: ONE month opened in full detail. A large condensed-sans month title "AOÛT" with "2026" beside it in small monospace, underlined by a 2px black rule. Beneath it a full data table: a left column of expense category names in condensed sans ("Salaire", "Loyer", "Assurance", "Courses", "Essence", "Sorties", "Abonnements") each with a small chevron and a tiny uppercase letterspaced monospace duration label, then six columns of monospace right-aligned amounts headed by tiny uppercase letterspaced labels reading "BUDGET  DÉPENSÉ  BALANCE  RÉEL  PRÉVU  SI DÉP.". Rows grouped into labelled bands: "CE QUI RENTRE" on a faint carbon wash, "DÉPENSES PRÉVUES" and "DÉPENSES NON PRÉVUES" on a faint red wash, then heavy total rows on a dark carbon wash at the bottom.
   - RIGHT, a narrow vertical rail about 22% wide, separated from the table by a strong 1px vertical hairline: FIVE stacked closed month cards, each a short horizontal band with the month name in condensed sans on the left ("JUIN", "JUILLET", "SEPTEMBRE", "OCTOBRE", "NOVEMBRE"), its closing balance beneath in large monospace ("2 813,00 €", "−240,50 €" in red), and a tiny uppercase monospace tag reading "PROJECTION" on the three future ones. The closed months are visibly quieter: no columns, no category names, just the month and its landing number. One of them shows a small solid black pill chip with white uppercase text "DÉPASSEMENT".

VISUAL WORLD, fixed and non-negotiable: absolutely no rounded corners anywhere; panel corners are cut at 45 degrees. No drop shadows, no gradients, no glass, no glow. Depth comes only from 1px hairline rules (#c7c3bd) and flat tonal washes. Palette strictly: warm concrete grey ground, lighter plate, near-black carbon ink, mid grey #6b6966 for labels, and exactly one accent, a signal red #d7262e, used only for negative amounts and overspend marks. No green, no amber, no blue. Typography: condensed grotesque sans for names and headings, monospace for every number and every tiny uppercase label. No charts, no pie graphs, no gauges, no sparklines, no illustrations, no icons beyond thin line arrows and chevrons. Matte, precise, engineering-drawing calm.
